messages:
Maya Patel: Quick prioritization thread for the unified API launch. Need decisions on cut scope and acceptance criteria before next week's roadmap review.
Liam Chen: Main trade: do we ship deterministic rerank now or after GA? pilots need deterministic, but it's risky.
Anika Gomez: If we delay deterministic rerank, we should still ship rerank with clear opt-in and strong quality gates. Suggest: GA = nondeterministic + metrics; Pilot = deterministic flag.
Ravi Singh: infra constraints: deterministic mode increases memory & KV pressure. Plan would require a dedicated pool for pilot customers. Cost trade needs sign-off.
Jordan Brooks: SDK needs: new optional param "response_mode" with values ["default","deterministic","throughput"]. We'll add client-side guardrails.
Sasha Ortiz: Product ask: customers care about per-route cost reporting. Add per-route cost headers (x-redwood-cost-units) for GA so early pilots can validate billing.
Maya Patel: Acceptance criteria proposal for GA slice:
- Contract stable: new params are additive only
- Perf: hosted 95th latency within targets (chat<=220ms, embed<=160ms, rerank<=350ms) on the GA traffic profile
- Quality: completions A/B swap rate <= 1.5% on seed set; embeddings mean cosine delta < 0.015 after quantization; rerank top-1 swap <= 2% vs baseline for nondeterministic
- Observability: per-route cost headers + tracing enabled by default for pilots
- Failures: documented fallback (unranked list + x-redwood-fallback: rerank_unavailable)
Liam Chen: Add gating: any quantization that causes embedding delta >0.02 is a hard block. QA must run the sweep on pinned corpora.
Anika Gomez: Also require an explicit check for long-tail prompts: prompts > 16k tokens should return 413 with "context_too_large" and suggested chunking guidance.
Ravi Singh: Edge case: partial responses when client cancels mid-stream. Server should emit finalization header and mark session cache as eligible for reuse after 5s.
Jordan Brooks: SDK behaviour: when "deterministic" selected, SDK should warn if used on free-tier (higher latency/cost) and suggest confirmation modal.
Sasha Ortiz: Pilot list: Atlas Analytics, Fathom Assist, Simplex Search. They need deterministic rerank + route-level metrics. I'll email invites after product signs off.
Maya Patel: Rollout plan idea:
- Feature flagged rollout: internal -> pilots (deterministic allowed) -> 10% public canary (nondet only) -> GA (nondet by default, deterministic opt-in for paid)
- Monitor: 95th latency, error rate, rerank quality regression, embedding stability, and cost-per-1000-tokens
Liam Chen: Tests: small eval harness for rerank top-1/top-3 stability + embed stability; QA to own maintenance.
Anika Gomez: Research: will run nightly quantization matrix (8/4/4-bit) and post stats to the spec doc. Anything above thresholds blocks rollout.
Ravi Singh: Infra tasks: allocate dedicated pool for pilots, tune KV eviction policy for deterministic sessions, add per-route cost accounting. I'll open tickets.
Maya Patel: Owners: product=Maya, infra=Ravi, research=Anika, SDK=Jordan, QA=Liam, pilot-coordinator=Sasha.
Maya Patel: Can people ack on the acceptance criteria here so I can update the PRD?
Jordan Brooks: ack from SDK side.
Liam Chen: ack for QA & tests.
Anika Gomez: ack for research, will post quantization results tonight.
Ravi Singh: ack for infra, opening tickets now.
Sasha Ortiz: ack and will start pilot outreach.
Maya Patel: perfect. I'll lock the GA feature-set in PRD and circulate a trimmed checklist. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
